description: This file contains PHP class definitions for managing page performance statistics and performance counters within the TestLink project. It provides classes 'tlPageStatistics' and 'tlPerformanceCounter' to track and display execution time, memory usage, and SQL query count for web pages.

classes.name: tlPageStatistics
classes.description: Handles the performance footer on pages, collecting and displaying performance metrics such as counters for overall performance.

classes.name: tlPerformanceCounter
classes.description: Represents individual performance counters tracking memory, time, and SQL query metrics; can output the current status as a string.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing performance statistics or counters, accepting database resource and counter type.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Destructor that echoes the performance output when the object is destroyed.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the performance counters, including memory, time, and SQL query info.

methods.name: startPerformanceCounter
methods.description: Starts a specific performance counter with a given title and type.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Calculates and returns the elapsed time since starting the timer.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets all performance metrics and counters.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops timing and updates memory and SQL information.

methods.name: updateMemory
methods.description: Updates current memory usage and peak memory.

methods.name: updateSQL
methods.description: Updates SQL query count and overall duration statistics.

methods.name: resetSQL
methods.description: Resets SQL query and duration counters.

methods.name: getmicrotime
methods.description: Returns current time in microseconds for timing purposes.
